title: LookBack: Where and How to Score LVLM Responses via Visual Reference Usage
abstract: arXiv:2608.11847v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) integrate visual perception with language generation, enabling responses that span image understanding and complex reasoning. However, LVLMs do not just inherit the text-level hallucinations; they also hallucinate against the image, producing fluent responses ungrounded in what they see. This makes LVLM response scoring inherently harder, and our diagnostics show that existing confidence-based metrics adopted from LLMs are insufficient for LVLMs. Specifically, removing the input image barely changes confidence-based selection, suggesting that output-space confidence primarily captures textual plausibility rather than agreement with the image. To address this gap, we propose LookBack, a training-free LVLM response scoring method that augments token likelihood with visual lookback score, a lightweight measure of how strongly each response token refers to image tokens. translated_title: 回顾：如何通过视觉参考使用来评分大型视觉-语言模型响应
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11847v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）将视觉感知与语言生成相结合，能够生成涵盖图像理解和复杂推理的响应。然而，LVLMs不仅继承了文本层面的幻觉，还会针对图像产生幻觉，生成流畅但未基于其所见内容的响应。这使得LVLM响应评分本质上更加困难，我们的诊断显示，从LLMs采用的现有基于置信度的指标对LVLMs并不充分。具体而言，移除输入图像几乎不会改变基于置信度的选择，这表明输出空间的置信度主要捕捉的是文本合理性，而非与图像的一致性。为解决这一差距，我们提出了LookBack，一种无需训练的LVLM响应评分方法，它通过视觉回顾分数增强令牌似然，这是一种轻量级度量，用于衡量每个响应令牌对图像令牌的引用强度。在四个基准测试和三个模型上，该方法表现出有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的LVLM响应评分方法LookBack，通过视觉回顾分数增强令牌似然，以解决现有置信度指标忽略图像一致性的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes LookBack, a training-free LVLM response scoring method that augments token likelihood with visual lookback score to address the insufficiency of existing confidence metrics in capturing image agreement.
